verdict.rationale: Penpot offers building blocks for non-interactive automation. Access tokens let apps call its API without an interactive login, outbound webhooks fire on file events, the API is pitched for workflow automation, and both Penpot and its MCP server can be self-deployed via docker compose or Helm, so an instance could be spun up inside a pipeline. None of the evidence documents a headless mode, CLI, or CI integration, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, so CI use would have to be assembled from the API and deployment tooling. Missing for 10: documented headless/CLI mode, CI pipeline guidance or examples, published API reference, hands-on corroboration of automated/CI usage.
